SEP 1 JOHN PAUL MORALES jpgargarmoraies@gmail.com Dear Mr. Morales: This refers to your. email addressed to the Commission on Election dated March 26, 2025, which was endorsed to this Department on April 22, 2025. Your email seeks our guidance regarding the six (6) months absence of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Chairman, who will be employed as a seaman abroad. You wish to be clarified on the actions to be taken, specifically conceming the communication protocols, the appointment of an acting leader, and the requisite adjustments to guarantee the continued operation of the SK council in the chairman's absence. Republic Act No. 10742 or the Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015 and its Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) provides for instances where succession and filling up of vacancies occur, thus — "SECTION 19. Succession and Filling up of Vacancies. — (a) In case a Sangguniang Kabataan chairperson refuses to assume office, fails to qualify, voluntarily resigns, dies, is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, the Sangguniang Kabataan member who obtained the highest number of votes in the election immediately preceding shall assume the office of the chairperson for the unexpired portion of his or her term. In case said member refuses to assume the position or fails to qualify, the Sangguniang Kabataan member obtaining the next highest number of votes shali assume the position of the chairperson for the unexpired portion of the term. xxx xxx xxx (e) If the reason for the vacancy in the office of the SK Chairperson does not fall under the conditions set forth in subsection (a) of this Section. the city or municipal mavor of the concemed baranqav shall appoint an Officer-in-Charqe (OIC) from a list of at least three (3) nominees as submitted bv all the SK members: Provided. fuHher. that the apzointed OIC must meet the qualifications set under Section 10 of this IRR. The DILG and the Commission shall issue the qujdelines for the implementation of this provision. " Under the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and National Youth Commission (NYC) Joint Memorandum Circular No. l, Series of 20241 Filling up of Vacancies in the Sangguniang Kabataan through Succession, Conduct of the Katipunan ng Kabataan (KK) Asernbly or Appointment by the Mayor "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

more particularly Item 4.2 re Filling Up Of Vacancy In the Office of the SK Chatrperson Through Appointment by the City/Municipal Mayor provides that — "4.2. I The appointment ofan OIC SK Chairperson by the Mayor shall be applicable if the reason for the vacancy does not fall under the conditions as enumerated in Section 4. I. I. I of this JMC 4.2.2 The Mayor of the concerned barangay shall appoint an officer-in-charge (OIC) from the list of at least three (3) nominees as submitted by all the SK members; Provided, further, that the appointed OIC must meet the qualifications set under Section IO of the Revised IRR of RA No. 10742, as amended; 4.2.3 The mayor is encouraged to observe the procedures as laid down in Annex "A" of this JMC" Applying the above, the temporary vacancy caused by the six-month overseas employment of the SK Chairperson does not fall under any of the grounds enumerated under subsection (a) of Section 19. Accordingly, the provisions of subsection (e) shall govern. Therefore, the city or municipal mayor of the concerned LGU shall appoint an OIC from a shortlist of at least three (3) nominees submitted by all the SK members, in accordance with the requirements and procedures set forth in JMC No. I, s. 2024. In view of the foregoing, and considering that this Department has not been apprised of the specific local government unit or Sangguniang Kabataan concerned, we strongly encourage coordination with the appropriate DILG Regional Office and the Commission on Elections to ensure adherence to the prescribed procedures and guidelines governing the appointment of an OIC SK Chairperson. This opinion is rendered without prejudice to any contrary interpretation or ruling by competent authorities or the courts of law. We hope to have been of assistance on the matter. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLA/LLLS-LLRALD/mag Page 2 of 2
